__comment: Snow weather. WeatherManager owns schedule and persistence.
sky_overrides.atmosphere smoothly overrides the clear atmosphere from data/sky/sky_settings.json.
Cloud cover and haze affect presentation; streaming, visibility budgets and the sun/moon light curves stay unchanged.
precipitation: falling flakes (doc 24, 'Rain and snow'); the shared keys are explained in rain.json. size_px is the flake
size in pixels of a 1080-line screen, sway its flutter in blocks, settle_seconds how long it rests on the ground.
